cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 reports a fine, sanction, licence withdrawal or complaint figures for digital financial services.
cells.note: Housekeeping 70: the cell held stage 4 with no rule in force on file, which the ladder needs (message 114). The regional central bank's fee cap on PI-SPI transfers, in force in Senegal from 2 November 2026 to protect consumers, is that rule, and the OQSF mediates financial-service disputes, so stage 4. Its 2025 complaint count covers all financial services and does not answer question 4, which is digital only (Bill, 2026-10-25).
